_doc_fog: BD40 (backdrop lane, 2026-10-11): cine.fog 0.25 matches the distance haze to the page's: the exponential height fog's density x 0.25 (client/tools/ar34/export/ue_light.py setup_fog, day 0.006 -> 0.0015); along the backdrop probes' lines of sight UE's day fog (density / 1000 per cm, base 2, falloff 0.12) held 4.3 times the page's optical depth from 250 to 300 m up and 3.5 times from the street (the page: 0.00016 per metre at its -25 m fog base, falloff 0.011, client/public/settings/graphics.json and weather.js); x 0.25 brings both within about 10 % (measured by day; every mode's density, golden, dusk and night, scales the same; docs/notes/r2-backdrop.md)
_doc: R1C (lane C, 2026-10-11): the trailer's cinematic preset of tools/ue/render_take.sh (--preset cine): the one-sample settings with 8 temporal samples a frame (the shutter's motion blur from the samples, the post-process blur off), Lumen with hardware ray tracing at cinematic quality (final gather 4, reflections, scene detail and lighting 4, screen probes at half the downsample, traced reflections to roughness 0.6, translucency's front layer), virtual shadow maps a level and a half sharper with 16 rays of 8 samples, a physical sky (sky atmosphere, volumetric clouds, a sky light that captures them), the exposure per shot (ev_shot, EV over the page's), 64 warm-up frames
_doc_gb43: GB43 (lead, 2026-10-12): anti-aliasing off with 8 spatial samples and 1 temporal (Movie Render Queue's offline path: TSR between temporal samples smeared windows, mullions and roof detail; 2 temporal samples streaked the actors that jump into place at a take's first frame across hundreds of metres). _doc_cine2: The re-shoot's preset (2026-10-15, the owner chose Lumen over path tracing): the cinematic preset with the sun's shadows ray-traced (r.RayTracing.Shadows; the virtual shadow maps' pages popped on facades as the lens moved), Nanite traced at full detail for Lumen's reflections, GI and those shadows (r.RayTracing.Nanite.Mode), and hit lighting for reflections
